title: Project Overview Modal
description: A project index where clicking any list item plays a paused GSAP timeline that slides a white detail overlay up from off-screen (bottom -1200px to 0) while un-rotating it from a 20deg tilt to flat with a power2.out ease; clicking Close or anywhere outside reverses the same timeline, and the overlay content (name, category, copy, link, image) is swapped in from a data array on open.

images.desc: Black-and-white editorial photo of a model in a flowing silk slip dress; shown by default and for the nanoweave fabrics and aero-adaptive shells studies
images.role: overlay detail image, shown by default and for items 1 and 6

images.desc: Black-and-white windswept editorial portrait; used for the bioluminescent trims and skin-sync textiles studies
images.role: overlay detail image for items 2 and 7

images.desc: Black-and-white editorial portrait of a model draped in sheer black fabric, matching the monochrome textile-studio identity; used for the shape-shifting knits and zero-waste weaves studies
images.role: overlay detail image for items 4 and 8

images.desc: Black-and-white editorial portrait of two models in tailoring on a high-key backdrop; used for the embedded electronics and cultured leather studies
images.role: overlay detail image for items 3 and 9

images.desc: Black-and-white studio image of a model seated on a stool; used for the holographic prints and neural-response studies
images.role: overlay detail image for items 5 and 10

intent.useWhen: Úsalo para un índice de proyectos donde al hacer clic en un item entra un panel de detalle deslizándose desde abajo con una rotación que se endereza.

motion.title: Project Overview Modal
motion.motion_signature: click-triggered overlay slides up from bottom:-1200px to 0 while un-rotating from a CSS-set 20deg about 'bottom center', 0.5s power2.out; close button and any outside click reverse the same paused timeline
